name: Yadori Tsugumi
source:
An actress attached to the Shadow Glove Troupe, a local theater group. She works with Kyota Hitome a lot, although he has more experience. 
A skilled ventriloquist, she often speaks through the snake puppet that she wears around her neck. 
In contrast to Tsugumi's bright personality, "Nekkun" is snarky and confrontational, almost as if he's not a part of her at all...
